description: [LocalSim L5] market_data.py: (a) quote_tradability_evidence / pre-trade gate (255-408) read TDX realtime last/open/high/low/book/turnover with NO timestamp/freshness check -> a frozen TDX client returns yesterday's prices which then drive same-day limit/tradability/fills (minute bars are date-checked, quotes are not). (b) _a_share_daily_limit_pct (1155) picks limit% only by code prefix so ST/*ST main-board (5%) are treated as 10% -> records impossible +6~10% fills. (c) the pre-trade gate never blocks BUY at limit-up / SELL at limit-down (only flags a fully-empty book), so one-sided sealed boards get over-optimistic fills. FIX: validate TDX quote freshness fail-closed (DataUnavailableError when timestamp missing/older than a bound vs as_of_time); detect ST/*ST and apply 5% (fail-closed if ST status unavailable); block side-appropriate intents at limit-up/limit-down with an explicit reason_code.
